claims.text: C2.r1 and C2.r2 describe separate Birch workloads, so add them to avoid undercounting.
Alder Query API's negative W3 counter difference means demand fell below zero; clamp it to zero.
Delta Query API's missing B2 sample invalidates both W2 and W3, despite the documented reset.
Cedar Query API is latency-eligible because three of its four individual histograms have more than 5% slow samples.
Cedar Write API's large failed-request count makes it an admissible positive-tier rollout target in this change window.
Delta Write API's maintenance interval should contribute neither traffic demand nor latency samples to this decision.
A plan that fits the credit budget is necessarily feasible; power, active-region and regional-block constraints do not need separate checks.
The collector deployment caused any post-B2 change in observed error fractions; these charts establish the causal effect.
